Done. `artifact.html` is created and verified — a single self-contained file, no external assets or libraries.

**Requirements check (verified in headless Chromium via Playwright):**

| Requirement | Result |
|---|---|
| Analyser ≥ 60 frequency bins | ✅ `fftSize: 512` → 256 bins |
| ≥ 3 visual modes, button-switchable | ✅ Bars / Rings / Particles — all switch, active state confirmed |
| File input | ✅ `<input type="file" accept="audio/*">` wired through `MediaElementSource` |
| Microphone | ✅ Tested with fake media device — status showed "Microphone live" (mic analyses only, not routed to speakers to avoid feedback) |
| Playback controls | ✅ Play/Pause, Stop, seek slider, time display, volume |
| Smooth animated rendering | ✅ Two frames 500 ms apart have different pixel hashes → animating; trail-fade compositing for smooth motion |
| Visible animation immediately on load | ✅ Screenshot shows bars drawing before any audio plays (idle wave fallback), 846k non-blank pixels |
| Loads without errors | ✅ Zero console errors / page errors across load, all three mode switches, and mic start |

Screenshots confirmed the bars render as a colorful gradient spectrum with reflections and particles drift with a reactive center glow. One note: the canvas uses a trail-fade effect (`rgba` overlay each frame), so modes blend smoothly rather than hard-clearing — intentional for smoothness.
